title: Type and shape
summary: Fonts, corners and the height of the bars.

requirements.text: Text is set in `font.body`, the device's own interface font. Code, ids, branch names and hashes are set in `font.mono`.
Cards, inputs and buttons have corners of `shape.radius`; sheets and dialogs of `shape.radius-large`.
